Recent advances of LLMs provide new opportunities to tackle the task without accessing tabular data by formulating it as a pairwise causal relation prediction task. Given a pair of variable names, an LLM is instructed to identify which is the cause and which is the effect using prompts, by distilling such knowledge directly from the LLM.

The outputs are causal direction predictions (e.g., X → Y, X ← Y, or no causal relation) based on yes-no questions and step-by-step explanations generated by LLMs.
